sections.heading: MINOR IN THANATOLOGY
lines: Completion of first-year requirements including Thanatology 1025A/B with a minimum grade of 60%.
1.5 additional courses in Thanatology at the 2200-level or above.
0.5 additional course in Thanatology at the 3000-level or above.

Note: A maximum 0.5 course from the following courses may be applied toward the additional courses required in Thanatology at the 2200-level or 3000-level above: Thanatology 2605A/B, Thanatology 2606A/B, Thanatology 3603A/B, Thanatology 3606F/G, Thanatology 3607A/B, the former Thanatology 2206F/G.
